findings.text: The requested_effective_date was changed from 2026-12-01 to 2027-01-01 without any supporting evidence quoted in the fix record. The fix_applied event for this field has empty evidence.

The election_type was changed from OEP to AEP based only on the received date, but there is no quoted evidence from the application indicating the applicant selected AEP. This is a substantive application change rather than a direct transcription correction.

The requested_effective_date was changed from 2026-11-01 to 2027-01-01 without quoted documentary evidence in the fix event. The source document explicitly shows "Requested effective date: 2026-11-01," while seq 10161 has empty evidence for the alteration.
